content.prompt:
Draw the following on the number line.
$$(1,3)$$

answer.short: Segment from 1 to 3, with both endpoints open.
answer.worked: Both round brackets exclude their endpoints. Draw open circles at 1 and 3 and join them with a segment.

spec.description: Double-arrow axis labelled 0 through 4; raised segment with open endpoints 1 and 3.
